doc: Three proofs of `fetch::fetch_text`, in three languages, each started as a process that reads one request and answers it. Paths are relative to this file.

environments.doc: Node 24 or later, which runs TypeScript by dropping the types.
A binary built from ../rust with `cargo build --release`. Until it is built, this environment is simply not there.

cost.notes: Linear in the size of the page.

implementations.notes: Where this is called `urllib.request.urlopen`. In the standard library, unlike `requests`.

cost.notes: Linear in the size of the page.

implementations.notes: Where this is called `fetch`. Decodes with `TextDecoder` rather than `response.text()`, which would ignore the declared charset.

cost.notes: Linear in the size of the page.

implementations.notes: Where this is called `ureq::get`. Decodes with `encoding_rs`, which reads charset labels the way browsers and Node do.
